products.quality: Rect/ellipse/triangle/polygon(n-sides)/star/dual-radius-star; parametric re-edit after creation via Shape Properties (corner radius, sides, points, bulge, ratio) persists through resize.
Same LightBurn-family shape suite (Draw Shapes, Draw Lines) plus a Tangent Circle Generator; documented in the current docs nav. Depth of parametric re-editing not independently verified.
No design canvas at all; usage docs cover only load/send G-code plus raster import. Design must happen in external software (Inkscape workflow is the community norm).
xTool Studio V1.7: line/rectangle/circle/polygon/star primitives plus a ready-made shapes panel; numeric corner-radius editing documented.
Basic set only: square, circle, triangle, star from the toolbar, plus a large clip-art icon library; no polygon/star parameter richness documented.
Shape creation covered by an official course lesson; primitive breadth and post-creation parametric editing not verified in this pass.
Richest primitive set of the roster: rectangle, circle, ellipse, polygon, star, line/polyline, arc, freehand draw, each with its own documented form dialog.

Pen (Draw Lines) plus Edit Nodes, convert-to-path, close-path tools. Community consensus: 'stripped-down Illustrator' - covers what matters for laser work, but complex path drawing is still commonly done in Inkscape/Illustrator.
Edit Nodes, Draw Lines, Convert to Path, Close Path and Trim Shapes all present in the current docs nav (LightBurn-family editor).

evidence.cite: https://docs.millmagesoftware.com/latest/ (nav lists Reference/EditNodes/, Reference/DrawLines/, Reference/ConvertToPath/, Reference/TrimShapes/)

products.quality: No pen or node editing; only automated bitmap vectorization of imported images.
xTool Studio: vector-path drawing, node editing with four node types (sharp/symmetric/asymmetric/angled), coordinate entry per node, path simplification and path splitting between nodes.
Pen tool (official walkthrough) and Edit Points editor: move points, toggle curved/straight segments. Simpler node model than desktop editors; no handle-type richness documented.
Polyline and Curve tools plus node editing; vendor blog documents a reworked node-editing experience with more consistent snapping.
Dedicated node-editing mode plus Fit Curves to Vectors (arc/bezier refit); community regards VCarve 2D drawing as sufficient for most CNC design work.
Boolean Tools (union/subtract/intersect), Cut Shapes, Auto-Join, Break Apart, and design-time Offset Shapes are all documented reference pages.
Boolean Tools, Cut Shapes, Break Apart, Trim Shapes and Offset Shapes all in the current docs nav - full LightBurn-family modify suite.

evidence.cite: https://docs.millmagesoftware.com/latest/ (nav lists Reference/BooleanTools/, Reference/CutShapes/, Reference/OffsetShapes/, Reference/TrimShapes/)

products.quality: No boolean or vector-modify operations; not a design tool.
xTool Studio pathfinder: Unite, Subtract, Unite-at-Overlap, Subtract-at-Overlap with real-time preview; plus offset-at-distance and compound-vector editing.
Design-time boolean limited to 'Combine' (union-style merge, then outline/edit points); subtract/intersect not documented as design ops - depth-per-shape carving substitutes at cut time.
Boolean operations and Offsets each have an official course lesson; community wiki calls booleans 'a very powerful ability to modify paths'.
Weld, Subtract, Overlap, Join Open Vectors, Offset, Extend, and Create Fillets - each a documented form dialog; the broadest modify set in the roster.

System fonts + Font Manager (2.1: search, favorites, categories); HSpace/VSpace spacing, bold/italic, auto-weld overlapping script characters, Bend Text around circles, Apply Path to Text, Variable Text, post-creation editing.
Create and Edit Text, Variable Text, and Apply Path to Text all present in the docs nav - LightBurn-family text engine.
No text creation tool documented anywhere in the official usage docs.
xTool Studio: font selection with weight/style, leading and character spacing, alignment, rotation, curve effects, and Weld/Unweld of overlapping characters.
Text editor with font menu (Pro tier adds 300+ fonts); curved text exists but only via apps (Curve Text/Path Warp) - community threads report multi-word curved text is clunky.
Text tool with spacing controls and convert-to-curves; curved/arched text shipped in V7 but community threads repeatedly report inconsistent availability and seek workarounds in later builds.
Create Text, Text On A Curve, and Convert Text to Curves are each documented form dialogs; sign-making is a core VCarve marketing use case.
Numeric Edits Toolbar for exact position/size, Two-Point Rotate/Scale for reference-point transforms, plus Radius/Fillet - all documented reference pages.
Numeric Edits Toolbar, Transform Controls, Two-Point Rotate/Scale, Flip/Mirror, and Radius/Fillet all in the docs nav.

evidence.cite: https://docs.millmagesoftware.com/latest/ (nav lists Reference/NumericEditsToolbar/, Reference/TransformControls/, Reference/TwoPointRotateScale/, Reference/FlipMirror/)

products.quality: No object transforms; only whole-image sizing during raster import (not design-time object editing).
xTool Studio: numeric X/Y position, width/height, rotation angle, and corner radius entry documented in the official overview.
Shape panel with numeric X/Y (selectable reference dot: corners/center), numeric size, angle rotation, plus a quick-rotate button.
Scale/rotate/move covered by the V5 manual and the Object Manipulation course lesson; skew/reference-point richness not verified.
Move Selection, Rotate, Mirror, Set Size, Distort Object, and an interactive Transform Mode - each a documented form dialog.
Align Tools and Distribute/Move Together documented as reference pages; dedicated measurement tooling not verified in this pass.
Align Tools and Distribute/Move Together both in the docs nav.
No alignment/distribution tooling; single-image workflow.
xTool Studio: horizontal/vertical/center alignment and even-spacing distribution documented in the official overview.
Dedicated Alignment Tools menu (align, distribute, layout) plus Edit > Center to Material.
Align Vectors tool (center-in-shape, align along X/Y); an Align/Space (distribute) tool appeared in build 764 per community threads.
Alignment Tools form dialog documented; grouping/ungrouping supports layout workflows.
Snapping reference page plus Automatic Guidelines documented in current 2.x docs.
Snapping and Automatic Guidelines both in the docs nav.
No canvas snapping/guides; not a design tool.
xTool Studio: auto-snapping toggle and configurable grid visibility/colors documented; draggable ruler guides not evidenced in this pass.
Snap alignment guides (to other shapes' centers/edges and material center/edge) are an official feature; grid snapping discussed in community threads.
View > Snap to Grid with adjustable grid spacing, plus shape-to-shape snapping; community threads note grid snap can fight precise placement (workaround: enlarge grid spacing).
Dedicated Snapping Options dialog documented (object and grid snapping configuration).
Grid Array, Circular Array, and Copy Along Path all documented as reference pages - full design-time array suite.
Grid Array and Circular Array in the docs nav; Copy Along Path not listed there (present in LightBurn).
No duplication/array tooling; single loaded file or image per job.
xTool Studio: grid array and circular array available via the Applications panel.
Grid replication only via the add-on Replicator app (App Library), not a native canvas tool; no circular array evidenced. Community threads ask for better rectangular-array workflows.
Object Arrays have an official course lesson; linear vs circular breadth not verified in this pass.
Array Copy, Circular Copy, and Copy Along Vectors - each a documented form dialog.
